x: Belgrave's outstanding performance came from Will Wesch who ripped through the laps to cover 7Miles 281 Yards, and finished third in section 'C'.

Our ever cheerful West German, Will Wesch, set the race walking world alight in the early months of 1969, when he won the Southern 'Garnet' 10 Miles Championship, the Surrey Co. 10 Miles Championship, the Ipswich H.
National '10' and Inter-Counties Champion, WILL WESCH.
WILL WESCH, whose popularity soon overflowed from the Walking Section into the rest of the Club when he joined us only 18 months ago, is the new National R.W.A.

Another Surrey Champion on view was Will Wesch, but he was unable to match Martin Bloice's example. He set the pace in the 10,000 metres walk for 85% of the race and then had to see Bob Coates "jump" him to go on to an impressive win.
